trust_decision.summary: The user-controlled GitHub URL subpath (basePath) is treated as trusted regex source when SkillParser.findSkillMd builds its fallback SKILL.md matcher; the fix decides it must be matched as a literal string.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'ReDoS in GitHub Skill Import'; the only user-input-interpolated new RegExp in the skill service is the basePath fallback in findSkillMd, and the importer log line at importer.ts:177 points straight to it.

fix_sites.entry_point: same as above; fix adds early 'not found' return so a basePath miss no longer falls through to root/first-level SKILL.md lookup (fix.diff:184-188)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No O2 site or O8 route exists; the only plausible dismissal is the behavioural change (no fall-through to the root SKILL.md on basePath miss), which a solver could argue is a feature change rather than part of the ReDoS fix.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A real directory whose literal name contains regex metacharacters (e.g. 'a.b') must still be found, and the fallback must still accept any single top-level '{repo}-{branch}/' segment when findGitHubRootPrefix picks a different prefix; an over-broad fix (rejecting metacharacters in basePath, or dropping the fallback) breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: basePath with nested-quantifier groups (catastrophic backtracking, e.g. '(a+)+')
basePath with invalid regex syntax (SyntaxError -> 500, e.g. '[invalid')
basePath with regex metacharacters that should be literal ('.' must not match any char)
basePath with leading/trailing slashes (normalised via replaceAll(/^\/|\/$/g, ''))

O8b_injection_room.sibling: first-level SKILL.md lookup built as new RegExp from a configurable skill-file name or directory hint instead of the constant pattern
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Adjacent code already uses a regex for the same path match; a maintainer adding a configurable filename or skill-name hint would likely interpolate it the same way as line 204.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: extractResources filtering resources by a regex built from basePath or the SKILL.md directory (e.g. to support include/exclude globs)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: extractResources receives the same user-derived path and does prefix matching by hand; converting that to a regex/glob matcher is a natural refactor.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: importFromUrl GitHub detection or a non-GitHub host route (e.g. GitLab tree URL) whose subpath is passed as basePath via a separate parser helper
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: importFromUrl already special-cases github.com and delegates; adding a second host would create a second implementation of the basePath lookup at distance.

O9_family: CWE-1333 ReDoS via user-controlled string interpolated into new RegExp (regex injection)

O10_build.project_tests: apps/server/src/services/skill/parser.test.ts (parseZipPackage with in-memory fflate ZIPs; no network or DB) and apps/server/src/services/skill/importer.test.ts (GitHub module mocked)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Wrap basePath in a regex-escape helper inside the existing new RegExp (or reject basePaths containing metacharacters), leaving the fall-through to the root SKILL.md on a miss.

out_of_scope_notes: packages/database/src/models/agentDocuments/policy/loadPolicy.ts:68 compiles rules.regexp from stored policy data with no apparent guard (different sink, not pursued).
packages/agent-runtime/src/core/InterventionChecker.ts:182 compiles a configured pattern with new RegExp (different sink, not pursued).
apps/server/src/services/bot/BotMessageRouter.ts:1795-1796 joins command names unescaped into a RegExp (different sink, not pursued).
unverified: O1 counts three public entry points: tRPC agentSkills.importFromGitHub (agentSkills.ts:171), tRPC agentSkills.importFromUrl which delegates GitHub tree/blob URLs (importer.ts:302-307), and the builtin skill-store tool's server runtime (apps/server/src/services/toolExecution/serverRuntimes/skillStore.ts:102-104). The CLI (apps/cli/src/commands/skill.ts:249) goes through the same tRPC route. These are all WHERE-type routes of one concept and fall together with the single parser fix.

Other regexes applied to the same URL input (apps/server/src/modules/GitHub/index.ts:55, apps/server/src/services/skill/importer.ts:304, zod .url()) were judged linear by reading only, not by measurement.
